general.miga: Employee Portal → Employment pools and Temporary Staff Requests → Current rules
general.ayudaQue: This page shows, read-only, the time limits, caps and lists that Employment pools and Temporary Staff Requests apply today.
general.ayudaOrigen: «Regulation» cites the article of the published Employment Pool Regulation. «Example» is a working value that HR has not yet approved; the «HR question» column says which question will settle it.
general.ayudaVersion: Each rule is identified by its catalogue and version. A change of value is published as a new catalogue version, without changing the software.
general.estado_sin_catalogo: No rule catalogue loaded: the module keeps its current behaviour.
general.estado_no_disponible: The rule catalogue is not available right now.
general.error_solicitud_invalida: The rules could not be requested. Press Try again and, if it still fails, tell IT.
general.error_servicio_no_disponible: The rules service is not available right now. Press Try again in a few minutes.
general.error_autenticacion_requerida: Identify yourself with your certificate to see the rules.
general.error_acceso_denegado: Your profile cannot see the rules.
general.error_respuesta: The rules could not be read. Press Try again and, if it still fails, tell IT.
general.ayudaDetalle: Press the name of a rule to read it in full: what it sets, the rule it is based on, the values it accepts and the HR question still open. Press it again to close it.
general.ayudaResolver: Rules cannot be changed on this page. The HR Department answers the open questions outside VEC. Once a value is approved, a new catalogue version is published and that is the version shown here.
general.detalleSinDescripcion: The catalogue does not describe this rule.
